mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (as measured by rolling 20-day returns over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a labor market slowdown that triggers corporate profit margin pressures and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a sell-off in equities; the joint signal predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (measured by 20-day forward returns) over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production declines by more than 0.5% over a 3-month period, it indicates a supply shock that increases input costs and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.5% over 3 months (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1500 (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.5% over 3 months (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market distortion, such as a mismatch between job openings and worker skills, which erodes investor confidence and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and PAYEMS growth fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (20-day forward returns) over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5%), the increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (over the last 5 years).
